lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed as a series of approximately five horizontal rows of discrete, high-luminance circular clusters. The arrangement follows a patterned distribution where clusters are spaced roughly equidistantly along the longitudinal axis posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Low-contrast vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a discernible grid-like matrix of high-luminance nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the superior lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and low-intensity pixels on the ventral edge.
